spans.s: गिर् f. (nom. sing. गीः) 1. Speech, speaking, language, प्रापयन् पवनव्याधेर्गिरमुत्तरपक्षताम् Sis.ii.15, भवतीनां सूनुतयैव गिरा कृतमातिथ्यम् Sak.i., Yaj.i.71, M.xi.35; 2. invocation, praise; 3. a name of Sarasvatī, the goddess of learning.
गीर्देवी f. Sarasvatī, the goddess of speech.
गीःपति m. 1. a name of Bṛhaspati, the preceptor of gods; 2. a paṇḍit, a learned man.
गीरथ m. an epithet of Bṛhaspati.
गीर्बाण m. a god, a deity, Bh.V.i.84.
गीर्बाण m. a god, a deity, Bh.V.i.84.
गिरा f. Speech, speaking, voice.
गिरि (I) a. Venerable, respectable.

गिरि (II) m. 1. A hill, a mountain, a rock, an elevation, तयोरेवांतरं गिर्योरार्यावर्ते विदुर्बुधाः M.ii.22; 2. a wooden ball with which children play; 3. a disease of the eyes; 4. an honorific title given to Sannyāsins, (e.g. Cf. आनंदगिरि); 5. the number ‘eight’ (in math.).
गिरि (III) f. 1. Swallowing; 2. a rat, a mouse (written also गिरी in this sense).
गिरि-इंद्र m. 1. a high mountain; 2. an epithet of Śiva; 3. the Himālaya mountain.
गिरि-ईश m. 1. an epithet of the Himālaya mountain; 2. an epithet of Śiva, गिरीशप्रतिसक्तमानसाम् K.S.v.3.
गिरिश m. An epithet of Śiva, गिरिशमुपचचार प्रत्यहं सा सुकेशी K.S.i.60, 37, प्रत्यहतास्रो गिरिशप्रभावात् R.ii.41.
गिरि-कच्छप m. a species of tortoise living in mountains.
गिरि-कंटक m. Indra’s thunderbolt.
गिरि-कदंब, -कदंबक m. a species of the Kadamba tree.
गिरि-कदंब, -कदंबक m. a species of the Kadamba tree.
गिरि-कंदर m. a care, a cavern.
गिरि-कर्णिका f. the earth.
गिरि-काण m. a blind or one-eyed man.
गिरि-कानन n. a mountain grove.
गिरि-कूट n. the summit of a mountain.
गिरि-गंगा f. name of a river.
गिरि-गुड m. a ball for playing with.
गिरि-गुहा f. a mountain cave.
गिरि-चर (I) a. living or wandering on a mountain, गिरिचर इव नागः प्राणसारं बिभर्ति Sak.ii.
गिरि-चर (II) m. a thief.
गिरि-ज (I) a. a mountain-born.
गिरि-ज (II) n. 1. talc; 2. red chalk; 3. benzoin; 4. bitumen; 5. iron.
गिरि-जा f. 1. a name of Pārvatī as the daughter of Himālaya; 2. the hill plantain; 3. the mallikā creeper; 4. a pebble, a small stone; 5. epithet of the Ganges.
गिरि-जा˚तनय, ˚नंदन, ˚सुत m. 1. an epithet of Kārtikeya; 2. of Gaṇeśa.
गिरि-जा˚तनय, ˚नंदन, ˚सुत m. 1. an epithet of Kārtikeya; 2. of Gaṇeśa.
गिरि-जा˚तनय, ˚नंदन, ˚सुत m. 1. an epithet of Kārtikeya; 2. of Gaṇeśa.
गिरि-जा˚पति m. an epithet of Śiva.
गिरि-जा˚मल n. Talc.
गिरि-जाल n. a range of mountains.
गिरि-ज्वर m. Indra’s thunderbolt.
गिरि-दुर्ग n. a hill fort, any stronghold among mountains, सर्वेण तु प्रयत्नेन गिरिदुर्गं समाश्रयेत् M.vii.71, 70.
गिरि-द्वार n. a mountain pass.
गिरि-धातु m. red cbalk.
गिरि-ध्वज n. Indra’s thunderbolt.
गिरि-नगर n. name of a district in Dakshiṇāpatha.
गिरि-णदी, -नदी f. a mountain torrent.
गिरि-णदी, -नदी f. a mountain torrent.
गिरि-णद्ध, -नद्ध a. inclosed by a mountain.
गिरि-णद्ध, -नद्ध a. inclosed by a mountain.
गिरि-नंदिनी f. 1. an epithet of Pārvatī; 2. of the Ganges; 3. river in general, कलिंदगिरिनंदिनीतटसुरद्रुमालंबिनीम् Bh.V.iv.3.
गिरि-णितंब, -नितंब m. the declivity of a mountain.
गिरि-णितंब, -नितंब m. the declivity of a mountain.
गिरि-पीलु m. name of a fruit tree.
गिरि-पुष्पक n. bitumen.
गिरि-पृष्ठ m. the top of a hill.
गिरि-प्रपात m. the declivityof a mountain.
गिरि-प्रस्थ m. the tableland of a mountain.
गिरि-प्रिया f. the female of the Bos grunniens.
गिरि-भिद् m. an epithet of Indra.
गिरि-भू (I) a. mountain-born.
गिरि-भू (II) f. 1. an epithet of the Ganges; 2. of Pārvatī.
गिरि-मल्लिका f. the kuṭaja tree.
गिरि-मान m. an elephant.
गिरि-मृद्, -मृद्भव n. red chalk.
गिरि-मृद्, -मृद्भव n. red chalk.
गिरि-राज् m. 1. a high mountain; 2. an epithet of the Himālaya.
गिरि-राज m. the Himālaya mountain.
गिरि-व्रज n. name of a city in the Magadhas.
गिरि-शाल m. a kind of bird.
गिरि-शृंग (I) m. an epithet of Gaṇeśa.
गिरि-शृंग (II) n. the peak of a mountain.
गिरि-षद् m. an epithet of Śiva.
गिरि-सानु n. tableland.
गिरि-सार m. 1. iron; 2. tin; 3. an epithet of the Malaya mountain.
गिरि-सुत m. the Maināka mountain.
गिरि-सुता f. an epithet of Pārvatī.
गिरि-स्रवा f. a mountain torrent.
गिरिक m. A ball for playing with.
गिरिका f. A small mouse.
गिरिक m. A ball for playing with.
गिरिक m. A ball for playing with.
गिलि(रि)त a. (f. ता) Eaten, swallowed.
गीर्ण a. (f. र्णा) 1. Swallowed; 2. described, praised, (pp. of गॄ q.v.).
गीर्ण a. (f. र्णा) 1. Swallowed; 2. described, praised, (pp. of गॄ q.v.).
गीर्णि f. 1. Praise; 2. fame; 3. swallowing.
